component.name: Voice2Text AI
component.summary: Fast native Linux dictation and local AI

description.p: Voice2Text AI records from your microphone, transcribes speech locally with Faster Whisper, sends prompts to a local Ollama model, and reads responses aloud with a natural neural voice and an offline eSpeak NG fallback.
The interface follows the system GTK and libadwaita theme, supports Wayland and X11, and uses PipeWire or PulseAudio through GStreamer.

screenshot.caption: Voice transcription and a streamed local AI response in dark mode

description.p: Rebuilt around GTK 4, libadwaita, and GStreamer with a modular, lower-overhead runtime.
